name: Meshy
what: A hosted 3D generation service with print tools. It makes a model from text, from one image or from two to four views, then textures, remeshes, converts, splits and colors it. Its print tools check printability for free, repair a mesh, split a model into printable parts, export a multi-color 3MF and turn a photo into a relief. A local MCP server exposes the API to an agent.
install: The user adds the official stdio server @meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server (repository meshy-dev/meshy-mcp-server) to the project's .mcp.json as a server named meshy, run through npx, with the API key in the MESHY_API_KEY environment variable of their own machine. The key never goes in chat or in a tracked file.
firstCall: the balance call, which is free, before any task that creates a model
evidenceNote: On 2026-11-27 the Meshy API and MCP documentation, the asset retention page and the terms of use were read. The server was not connected and no call ran. Credits are charged when a task is created; failed tasks are refunded. API downloads expire, and non-Enterprise API assets are deleted after three days. Free-plan output is licensed to the customer under CC BY 4.0 with credit to Meshy; paid-plan customers own their output. Non-Enterprise inputs and outputs may be used for training. The terms page carried a last-updated date later than the read date; read it again before quoting it.
